s1.syndrome_frame: Acute abdominal syndrome with chronic abdominal pain and vomiting, featuring a tender abdominal mass
salient_findings: Large, firm, tender mass near the umbilicus
Diffuse lymphadenopathy and mesenteric mass on CT
key_facts: Normal passage of stool and flatus
Large, firm, tender mass near the umbilicus
Low bicarbonate, low PCO2, marginally acidotic pH on venous blood gas
No evidence of infection on urinalysis and blood cultures
CT Abdomen findings: Diffuse lymphadenopathy and a large mesenteric mass
Mesenteric mass abutting multiple segments of small intestine and encasing the mesenteric vasculature

raw.syndrome_frame: Acute abdominal syndrome with chronic abdominal pain and vomiting, featuring a tender abdominal mass
salient_findings: Large, firm, tender mass near the umbilicus
Diffuse lymphadenopathy and mesenteric mass on CT
key_facts: Normal passage of stool and flatus
Large, firm, tender mass near the umbilicus

Mesenteric mass abutting multiple segments of small intestine and encasing the mesenteric vasculature

differentials: Intra-abdominal desmoplastic small round cell tumor
per_call: Intra-abdominal desmoplastic small round cell tumor

shortlist.label: Lymphoma
shortlist.why_kept: Diffuse lymphadenopathy and a large mesenteric mass on CT Abdomen

shortlist.label: Mesenteric panniculitis
shortlist.why_kept: Tender abdominal mass and mesenteric mass abutting multiple segments of small intestine

shortlist.label: Sclerosing mesenteritis
shortlist.why_kept: Chronic abdominal pain and mesenteric mass encasing the mesenteric vasculature

shortlist.label: Gastrointestinal stromal tumor
shortlist.why_kept: Large, firm, tender mass near the umbilicus and elevated lactate levels

shortlist.label: Desmoid tumor
shortlist.why_kept: Large mesenteric mass and history of chronic abdominal pain

raw.rationale: The presence of diffuse lymphadenopathy and a large mesenteric mass on CT abdomen, along with systemic symptoms such as nausea, vomiting, and elevated lactate levels, suggests a malignant process. Lymphoma is a type of cancer that can cause these symptoms and imaging findings.

rejected.label: Mesenteric panniculitis
rejected.why: It typically presents with a more chronic course and less systemic symptoms

rejected.label: Sclerosing mesenteritis
rejected.why: It usually presents with chronic abdominal pain and less prominent systemic symptoms

rejected.label: Gastrointestinal stromal tumor
rejected.why: It typically presents as a solitary mass, not with diffuse lymphadenopathy

rejected.label: Desmoid tumor
rejected.why: It is a benign tumor that does not typically cause systemic symptoms or elevated lactate levels
